name: Freezing recurrent layers first improves hybrid retrieval
title: Freezing recurrent layers first improves hybrid retrieval
summary: A paper on hybrid recurrent-attention models finds that recurrent layers learn retrieval faster and keep attention from learning it. Better Layer Division freezes the recurrent layers early so attention learns retrieval first. At 750M, RULER accuracy rises from 26.53% to 32.82% and long-context perplexity falls from 12.68 to 8.08.
